probe_history.reason: Carries forward london-t2-watford-colosseum-02's own probe_history -- retained here as INSUFFICIENT for the new question this record answers (does the venue's real geographic location fit this tranche's London/UK map scope?).

Fully answers the question with no further escalation needed.
